personas.name: Australia Cohort
personas.description: Australian DoorDash user. Category mix and notification reachability differ from the US baseline; grocery is a larger share of demand in this market.
personas.jtbd: Get household and grocery essentials via DoorDash in a market with fewer restaurant alternatives.

personas.name: Caviar SMS Loyalist
personas.description: Orders on the Caviar brand surface (not core DoorDash). SMS-reachable, not push-heavy. Expectations of restaurant quality and brand tone differ from mainstream DD users.
personas.jtbd: Order from premium/curated restaurants on a brand they trust, with low promotional noise.

personas.name: Healthy DashPass Subscriber
personas.description: Active DashPass member where the subscription is paying off — health-of-subscription is well above baseline, fee burden is below baseline. Stable, profitable user for the marketplace.
personas.jtbd: Use DashPass as a cost-saving wrapper around regular delivery orders.

personas.name: Notification-Fatigued Engaged User
personas.description: Orders regularly but marketing volume exceeds tolerance. Uninstalls and unsubscribes spike after notification campaigns. Sensitive to push/email frequency.
personas.jtbd: Order when needed; aggressively reduce promotional noise from the app and brand.

personas.name: DashPass Grocery Power User
personas.description: DashPass subscriber with high app engagement and grocery-leaning NV orders. Treats DoorDash as an everyday grocery delivery channel; subscription justifies frequent use.
personas.jtbd: Maximize DashPass value through frequent grocery + restaurant orders.

personas.name: Discount-Driven Restaurant Regular
personas.description: Lukewarm on DashPass (low subscription health) but receives larger-than-average fee discounts; orders concentrate on restaurants via iOS. Engagement is fee-promotion sensitive — pricing changes will move this segment.
personas.jtbd: Order restaurant delivery when the fee math works out — promotions and discounts matter.

personas.name: Unreachable Disengaged User
personas.description: Active orderer but unreachable via notifications — profile flagged UNK on reach status. Engagement happens through direct app use, not marketing. Lower order frequency and fewer NV orders than baseline.
personas.jtbd: Order on DoorDash without marketing pull; surfaces only when the user comes to the app directly.

personas.name: Fixed — Dormant Resurrected
personas.description: Pre-defined lifestage segment: Dormant Resurrected. NOT discovered via clustering — assigned by lifestage rule.
personas.jtbd: Lifestage-derived; behaviorally similar to Active users in residual dimensions, but at a different point in the consumer lifecycle.
